catalogue_card.question: Is GTA 6 still listed for November 19?
catalogue_card.text: Yes. Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A new performer NDA report traces to one podcast and has no independent confirmation. It does not change the date; PC remains unannounced.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
No new official schedule change was found in the checked Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, Xbox, and Support pages.

Rockstar’s September 24 Goodtime State collection and September 17 soundtrack are scheduled for November 19; the game is sold separately from the collection. These products show commercial activity, not software readiness.
PlayStation labels the game PS5 Pro Enhanced but publishes no performance target or Pro requirement; PC has no official platform or date.
A report about a performer NDA reminder traces to one podcast. Reviewed coverage gives no email, named recipient, or independent confirmation.
Take-Two’s general PC strategy comments do not announce GTA VI for PC.
uncertainty: November 19 is an official console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two previous official date movements remain relevant.
PS5 Store unlock times are operational data and may change; they do not establish Xbox timing.
PS5 Pro Enhanced is an official label, but no checked source gives a performance target or says a Pro is required.
Soundtrack and merchandise plans show launch activity, not that the game is finished.
The performer NDA story has one reported source chain and no independent confirmation in the checked articles.
No official PC platform or date is published; general company PC strategy and historical patterns are not GTA VI announcements.
The first-party analytics broker was unavailable; no pool visit, return use, decision, or revenue is observed.
